# SSMaker

SSMaker is a Windows desktop AI video automation tool for Korean ecommerce operators. It converts Chinese shopping source videos into Korean short-form sales videos and connects the workflow to Coupang Partners links, YouTube Shorts upload, and Linktree product-link verification.

## Canonical
- Website: https://shoppingshorts.store/
- Product name: SSMaker
- Korean name: 쇼핑 숏폼 메이커
- Category: AI video editing automation / ecommerce marketing software
- Platform: Windows desktop
- Language: Korean
- Region: South Korea

## Core Answers
- What is SSMaker? A Windows AI program that detects Chinese shopping-video subtitles, blurs existing captions, creates Korean sales scripts, synthesizes Korean TTS, and exports shopping Shorts.
- Is a Coupang API key required? No. If the user already has a Coupang Partners short link such as https://link.coupang.com/a/..., they can paste that link into SSMaker. Coupang API keys are optional for converting original coupang.com URLs into affiliate deep links.
- How does Linktree automation work? Basic setup only needs the public Linktree profile URL. Fully automatic Linktree card creation requires a user-provided webhook endpoint such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or Cloudflare Worker.
- What is needed for YouTube upload? Google Cloud YouTube Data API v3 must be enabled and a desktop-app OAuth client JSON must be connected. A simple API key or service account is not enough for normal YouTube channel upload.
- Pricing? Free trial is 0 KRW with 5 monthly runs. The only paid plan is the Pro monthly subscription at 149,000 KRW per month. There are no annual or multi-month plans.
- Who is it for? Korean cross-border commerce sellers, Smart Store operators, Coupang Partners creators, and YouTube Shorts shopping-channel operators.
